name: jsonpatch
spec: Input [document,operations]. Operations [op,path,value] for add/replace/test, [remove,path]. Implement JSON Pointer (~1=/, ~0=~), dict/list navigation. add inserts list index or appends at -, replace/remove require existing target; dict add may overwrite. test compares JSON values. Empty pointer denotes root (remove root sets null). On any invalid op/path/test failure return {"ok":false,"document": ORIGINAL}; otherwise {"ok":true,"document":updated}. All changes atomic, input not mutated. Reject negative indices and leading-zero list indices except 0.

name: semver
spec: Rows are SemVer 2.0.0 strings (valid core major.minor.patch). Return stable ascending precedence order. Ignore +build metadata in comparison. Release > prerelease. Prerelease dot identifiers: numeric compare as integers and precede nonnumeric; nonnumeric compare ASCII; shorter equal prefix precedes longer. Preserve original strings and input order for precedence ties.

name: glob
spec: Input [pattern,text]. Return boolean full match. Glob: ? matches one character except /; * matches zero or more except /; ** matches zero or more INCLUDING /. Backslash escapes next character; trailing backslash is literal backslash. Other characters literal. No implicit slash absorption by **/. Unicode codepoints.

name: scc
spec: Rows are directed string edges. Return strongly connected components including nodes mentioned in any edge; each sorted and components lexicographically sorted. Self loops count; duplicates ignored.

name: mst
spec: Input [node_names,undirected_weighted_edges], each edge [u,v,integer_weight]. Return minimum spanning FOREST total weight (connect each connected component), ignoring self loops. Negative weights and parallel edges allowed; isolated nodes contribute 0.

name: matching
spec: Input [left_nodes,right_nodes,edges]. Return maximum cardinality bipartite matching SIZE. Edges are [left,right]; duplicates allowed. Left/right identifiers may overlap as strings but belong to distinct sets.

name: negativepaths
spec: Input [nodes,edges,source,target], directed edges [u,v,integer_weight]. Return shortest distance, null if unreachable, string "-infinity" if some reachable negative cycle can reach target. An irrelevant reachable negative cycle must not poison other target distances.

name: editdistance
spec: Input [source,target,insert_cost,delete_cost,replace_cost]. Return weighted Levenshtein distance over Unicode characters. Costs nonnegative integers; replacement may be more expensive than delete+insert.

name: matrixchain
spec: Input list of positive matrix dimensions [d0,d1,...,dn]. Return minimum scalar multiplications to multiply n matrices. Length 0 or 1 represents no matrices and returns 0.

name: knapsack
spec: Input [capacity,items], items [weight,value], nonnegative integer weights including zero, integer values including negatives. Each item used at most ONCE. Return maximum value with total weight <=capacity, empty selection allowed.

name: lru
spec: Input [capacity,operations]. Operations ["put",key,value] and ["get",key]. get returns stored value or null on miss. Both get hits and put update recency; evict least recently used when needed; capacity 0 retains nothing. Return list of GET responses only. False/0/null values remain legitimate cached entries.

name: ttl
spec: Input [ttl,operations]. Operations [time,"put",key,value], [time,"get",key]; times nondecreasing integers. put replaces value and expires at time+ttl. get does NOT refresh expiry. Entry expired when now>=expiry. ttl=0 expires immediately. Return get responses (null on miss).

name: csv
spec: Input CSV string. Return list of rows, all cells strings. RFC4180-style commas and double-quote escaping, quoted embedded newlines, CRLF or LF record separators. Empty input -> []; blank record -> [""]. Final newline does not add extra record. Use strict CSV parsing; malformed input not tested.

name: rpn
spec: Rows are reverse Polish notation tokens, integer literals or + - * /. Return exact integer result; division truncates toward ZERO with arbitrary precision (no float). Stack malformed or divide-by-zero -> null. Empty is malformed.

name: rational
spec: Input [expressionA,expressionB,op], rationals as strings numerator/denominator (signed integers, denominator nonzero), op + - * /. Return reduced canonical fraction string with positive denominator, including /1. Divide by zero -> null. Exact arbitrary precision.

name: stablemerge
spec: Rows are sorted nondecreasing integer lists (many possibly empty). Return merged sorted list preserving all duplicates. Must handle negative values and empty outer list.

name: median
spec: Rows are operations ["add",integer], ["remove",integer], ["median"]. Multiset remove deletes one occurrence, missing remove no-op. Return medians for queries: null when empty; middle value for odd; arithmetic mean of middle two for even. Include negatives, duplicates, removals.

name: prefix
spec: Input [dictionary_words,queries]. Return for each query the lexicographically first word among the LONGEST dictionary words that are prefixes of that query, or null if none. Dictionary duplicates irrelevant. Empty string is a valid prefix.

name: wildcarddecode
spec: Input digit string containing digits 0-9 and *. Count decodings into letters 1..26; * can mean any digit 1..9. Return count modulo 1000000007. Empty string has one decoding. Zeros cannot stand alone.

name: grid
spec: Input rectangular grid of 0/1 (1 blocked), [] or [[]] empty. Return number of paths top-left to bottom-right moving right/down, modulo 1000000007. Blocked endpoints ->0. Do not mutate grid.
